source: Government of India reservation policies, JoSAA/CSAB certificate formats and counselling rules

OPEN.description: General category. No caste/income restriction for seat allocation itself.
OPEN.certificate_required: None for seat. Income certificate may be needed for fee waivers.

OBC_NCL.fullName: Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer

certificate_details.must_be: Central Government OBC list (NOT state OBC list)
certificate_details.format: Government of India format with specific Office Memorandum reference
certificate_details.OM_reference: DoPT OM No. 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.1993 and subsequent modifications
certificate_details.validity: Must usually be issued on or after April 1 of the admission year; verify the current JoSAA/CSAB format and instructions
certificate_details.issuing_authority: Competent government authority (District Magistrate, Sub-Divisional Magistrate, etc.)
certificate_details.income_limit: Family income must be below Rs 8 lakh per year to be Non-Creamy Layer
certificate_details.state_vs_central: CRITICAL: Many states have their own OBC lists which may include castes not in Central list. Only Central OBC list valid for JoSAA.

creamy_layer_definition.income_threshold: Rs 8 lakh per year gross annual income (both parents combined)
creamy_layer_definition.excludes_also: Constitutional posts, Group A/B services officers, military officers above Colonel rank
creamy_layer_definition.assets_based_exclusion: Agricultural land above certain limits in some states

common_issues: State OBC certificate used instead of Central OBC certificate
Certificate expired (older than current financial year)
Caste listed in state OBC list but not in central OBC list
Maharashtra: Needs additional Caste Validity Certificate

certificate_details.format: State Government format (each state has its own)
certificate_details.issuing_authority: District Magistrate / SDM / Tehsildar as per state rules
certificate_details.validity: No expiry (unlike OBC/EWS). A permanent certificate.

special_states.Maharashtra: Need Caste Validity Certificate from Social Welfare Department in addition to caste certificate

SC.fee_benefit: 100% tuition fee waiver at IITs. Significant fee concession at NITs.

special_states.Maharashtra: Needs Caste Validity Certificate from Tribal Welfare Department
special_states.Tamil Nadu: Must be issued by Revenue Divisional Officer (RDO) specifically

EWS.rank_used: EWS category rank (similar to CRL for this category)
EWS.for_whom: General category families who do not fall under SC/ST/OBC but have low income

certificate_details.income_limit: Gross annual family income below Rs 8 lakh per year

assets_criteria.note: Family should not own more than ONE house/property above these limits

certificate_details.format: Central Government prescribed format (available on josaa.nic.in)
certificate_details.validity: Must be issued on or after April 1 of admission year
certificate_details.issuing_authority: District Magistrate / Additional District Magistrate / Collector / Deputy Commissioner / Additional Deputy Commissioner / First Class Stipendary Magistrate / Sub-Divisional Magistrate / Taluka Magistrate / Executive Magistrate / Extra Assistant Commissioner (not below rank of First Class Stipendary Magistrate)

common_rejection_reasons: Certificate issued before April 1 of current year
Issued by wrong authority (e.g., village sarpanch, gram panchayat)
Income calculation error (all family members' income not included)
EWS.important_note: EWS benefit is for GENERAL category families only. SC/ST/OBC families are NOT eligible for EWS even if income is low.

PwD.meaning_of_horizontal: 5% within each category. E.g., 5% of OPEN seats for OPEN-PwD, 5% of SC seats for SC-PwD
PwD.benchmark_disability_definition: 40% or more disability as certified by competent authority

types_of_disability.Other: Autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability, mental illness

certificate_details.format: Prescribed format from JEE Advanced/Main information brochure
certificate_details.issuing_authority: Medical Board constituted by Central/State Government
certificate_details.disability_percentage: Must clearly state percentage of disability (minimum 40%)
certificate_details.special_case: If disability is less than 40% but candidate has difficulty in writing, a separate certificate needed

PwD.scribe_facility: Available for candidates with writing difficulty. Apply during JEE registration.
PwD.exam_accommodation: Extra time, scribe, other accommodations as per disability type

DS.type: Supernumerary seats (additional seats, not from regular quota)
eligibility: Children of Defence personnel killed in action
Children of Defence personnel disabled in action with disability pension
Children of serving armed forces personnel
DS.certificate: From commanding officer / service records / pension documents
DS.seats: Usually 1-2 supernumerary seats per institute per program

Kashmiri_Migrant.eligibility: Kashmiri Pandits / migrants who left Jammu & Kashmir due to militancy
Kashmiri_Migrant.certificate: Migration certificate from Divisional Commissioner or Relief Commissioner, J&K

CRL.how_it_works: All JEE candidates ranked together regardless of category

OBC_NCL_rank.how_it_works: Separate rank list prepared from all OBC-NCL candidates who qualify JEE

rank_types.SC_rank: Separate rank list for SC candidates
rank_types.ST_rank: Separate rank list for ST candidates
rank_types.EWS_rank: Separate rank list for EWS candidates (similar to CRL range)
rank_types.PwD_rank: Rank within each category for PwD candidates
rank_types.Preparatory_rank: Rank for SC/ST/PwD candidates for preparatory course seats at IITs (suffixed with P in JoSAA data)

JEE_Main_specific.NTA_score: Score out of 300 in JEE Main
JEE_Main_specific.Percentile: Percentile score based on all candidates who appeared. Different from NTA score.
JEE_Main_specific.CRL_rank: All India rank in JEE Main based on percentile. Used for NIT/IIIT/GFTI admissions.
JEE_Main_specific.Category_rank: Rank within category (OBC/SC/ST/EWS). Used for reserved category seats.
JEE_Main_specific.normalization: Multi-session normalization applied to equalize difficulty across sessions
JEE_Main_specific.best_of_two: Best score from two attempts considered (from 2026 onwards)

JEE_Advanced_specific.Paper_1_and_2: Both papers mandatory. Both marks counted.
JEE_Advanced_specific.Zone_rank: IITs divided into zones. Zone rank for tiebreaking.
JEE_Advanced_specific.Aggregate_marks: Sum of Paper 1 and Paper 2 marks
JEE_Advanced_specific.Minimum_aggregate: Must score minimum marks in each paper AND aggregate

class12_eligibility.OR: Top 20 percentile of successful candidates in their respective state board
class12_eligibility.which_is_applied: Whichever is MORE relaxed (75% OR top 20 percentile, whichever gives benefit to candidate)
class12_eligibility.year_of_passing: Class 12 must have been passed in the year of JEE or one year prior (2-year window)

subjects_required.BTech: Physics, Mathematics, and any one of Chemistry/Biology/Biotechnology/Technical Vocational

class12_eligibility.year_window_example: For JEE 2026, Class 12 must be from 2026 or 2026 (first attempt in 2026 or 2026)

reservation_seat_calculation_example.note: Exact numbers depend on total seats and rounding rules in JoSAA business rules
